profile.name: USBlini USB-LIN总线接口
profile.description: 这是一种通过 USB 连接的 LIN 总线接口设备，用于在实验或测试系统中配置 LIN 通信速率、发送主站帧、设置从站帧表、编排主站轮询序列，并接收帧、状态和逻辑相关回调，适合 LIN 总线联调、协议测试与设备仿真。
profile.description_en: This is a USB-connected LIN bus interface device used in lab or test setups to configure LIN communication speed, send master frames, define slave frame tables, schedule master sequences, and receive frame, status, and logic-related callbacks. It is suitable for LIN bus integration, protocol testing, and device emulation.
